pages.text: Each level of Dark Denizen reduces projectile damage by 5% on a helmet, 15% on a chestplate, 10% on leggings, and 5% on boots. These bonuses add together up to a 70% reduction.

Shields gain 8% block amount and 4% block angle per level. At four or more combined levels across worn armor and held shields, gain continuous Regeneration II, plus 1.5% damage and one knockback level per combined level.
